Requires public Godot 4.7.2 or newer and matching export templates.

Includes debug and release libraries for macOS 13+ Apple Silicon, iOS 16+ arm64
(device only), and Android API 29+ arm64. The macOS libraries provide simulated
desktop AR. Mobile targets need supported ARKit/Metal or ARCore/Vulkan hardware.

Download the addon ZIP, unzip it into your project and enable PocketAR in
Project Settings → Plugins. The tap-to-place ZIP contains a standalone sample.
See the [README](https://github.com/doublesymmetry/pocketar/blob/@TAG@/README.md)
for setup, platform requirements and limitations. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
